searchText: Strange. That should be something with our RPC endpoint. I'll check and fix it <@!552133098075193354> We're rejecting these transactions, but it looks like other clients are informing about rejection in their RPC endpoints. We're returning txhash no matter if the tx is valid or not. I'm not surprised that it confused <@!360491619402776577> . However, we'll discuss internally why we're doing it in this way. Maybe, there are some good reasons for that.
